hook: Today-you keeps robbing future-you. And future-you can't fight back.

scenes.say: Today-you keeps robbing future-you. And future-you can't fight back.
Present bias: rewards right now look huge. Costs later look tiny.
scenes.show: Now looks huge. Later looks tiny.

scenes.say: Take the easy path today, and the bill lands later, with interest.
Take the hard path today, and the reward quietly stacks up.
It's not weak willpower. Your brain evolved to grab what's in front of it.
scenes.show: Your brain grabs what's in front.

scenes.say: Plans for the future always look reasonable. Then the future turns into today.
Don't rely on willpower. Automate the good choice, like saving before you spend.

takeaway: Don't rely on willpower. Automate the good choice, like saving before you spend.
